Kit summary

Hammer Shield ComboBasic
Deals 2 stages of 140% DEF DMG each to a single enemy, the first stage of which has a 70% chance to reduce the target's ATK by 40% for 2 turns, and the second stage has a 70% chance to inflict [Horrify] on the enemy for 1 turn.
Brashly TauntActiveExclusive Lv.1
Mamuk grants self [Taunt] and [Immortal] for 2 turns, and increases all allies' SPD by 40% for 2 turns.
Mana Shield Hammer Lv.1Mamuk gains 1 layer of [Engulfing Power] for every 5% of Max HP lost after casting Brashly Taunt, up to 12 layers. Mamuk consumes all the [Engulfing Power] at the end of his second turn after casting Brashly Taunt, and restores HP for all allies by 2% of Mamuk's Max HP for each layer of [Engulfing Power] consumed, or immediately consumes all the granted [Engulfing Power] to restore HP for allies if Mamuk dies before this effect is triggered.
RefreshingPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Mamuk is immune to [Freeze], [Stun], and [Hypnotize]; Mamuk grants any ally a [Shield] by 28% of Mamuk's Max HP for 2 turns if the ally takes single skill DMG that is above 20% of Max HP or is inflicted with any of [Freeze], [Stun], or [Hypnotize]. CD: 2 turns for each ally.
Mana Shield Hammer Lv.2Mamuk has an additional 35% Healing Effect. Besides, Mamuk grants self extra Max HP Cap by 30% of self Healing Effect (caps at 45% of Max HP Cap) at the beginning of the battle.
Energy SnatchActiveExclusive Lv.3
Steals all buffs (except attribute buffs) from all enemies, deals 260% DEF DMG to all enemies, and extends the duration of all buffs on self by 1 turn.
Mana Shield Hammer Lv.3Whenever Energy Snatch steals 1 buff from an enemy, Mamuk absorbs 5% of their Max HP (caps at 15% of his Max HP for each buff), or restores HP for all allies if Mamuk's HP percentage is 100% when absorbing.
